projectMove.title: Shore day for you; Arena Phase 26 watching overnight
projectMove.body: Enjoy Cozumel. Ashore, Arena Phase 25 finished clean last night on Grok Build, and Phase 26 (main menu, settings, game presentation) was already running on grok-4.7. Testarossa watches and pings Diablo only on finish or a wall. No cruise-autonomy pings needed from you.

tip.title: Snorkel early, shade midday
tip.body: Morning water is the gift: near-glass seas and cooler UV. After noon the feel climbs toward 95F and shower chances rise, so keep shade and water handy, then leave yourself real time to clear security and be aboard before the 4 PM sail.

surprise.title: 104 years ago today, one stone step opened Tutankhamun's tomb
surprise.body: On November 4, 1922, Howard Carter's team in Egypt's Valley of the Kings uncovered a single step, the top of what turned out to be a sixteen-step staircase down to tomb KV62. Behind it was the most complete royal burial ever found in the valley: 5,398 objects, from coffins and furniture to clothing and jewelry, packed into four small chambers. It survived because it was dug low into the valley floor, and flood debris and later construction buried the entrance, so it escaped the stripping that emptied the other royal tombs. Robbers did get in twice shortly after the burial, yet the pharaoh's mummy and most of his treasures stayed put for more than three thousand years. A good story for your last sea day before home.
